name: wrong_polynomial
why: uses the CRC-16/IBM polynomial 0x8005 instead of 0x1021

name: reset_init_zero
why: reset starts the first frame from 0x0000 (XMODEM init) instead of 0xFFFF

name: reset_keeps_frame
why: reset clears the slot but leaves the partial frame CRC in place

name: no_restart_after_last
why: the byte after a frame end continues the old frame's CRC

name: reflected_input_bits
why: processes each byte LSB first (reflected input, as in CRC-16/KERMIT)
replace: c = crc_in ^ {data[0], data[1], data[2], data[3], data[4], data[5], data[6], data[7], 8'h00};

name: capture_while_blocked
why: accepts a byte on in_valid alone, overwriting a stalled output and advancing the CRC

name: throughput_bubble
why: ready ignores out_ready, so a full slot cannot retire and refill in one cycle

name: dropped_last_flag
why: out_last never reports the frame end

name: valid_dropped_under_stall
why: out_valid clears on an idle cycle even while out_ready is low

name: asynchronous_reset
why: an off-edge reset pulse clears the occupied slot
replace: always @(posedge clk or posedge rst) begin
